thoughts: "Product Managemeent" lines up best with the department's Web & Mobile track, so its electives come first.
Starting from semester 1 with calculus placement.
The longest prerequisite chain is CSC 101 → CSC 215 → CSC 220 → CSC 317 → CSC 413 → CSC 642, so CSC 101 has to start early.
Electives (15 units): CSC 642, CSC 667, CSC 668, CSC 675, CSC 680.
Keeping each semester near 18 units, under the 19-unit priority-registration cap.
raw.rationale: I matched "Product Managemeent" to Web & Mobile and chose Human-Computer Interaction, Internet Application Design and Development, Advanced Object Oriented Software Design and Development and more, because they build directly on your core courses and point at that career.
